messages.cognia.agent-prompt.cognia-answer.purpos: Organize or answer using only the selected fixed material versions and cite sources with markers such as [S1]
messages.cognia.agent-prompt.cognia-answer.title: Organize knowledge and answer questions
messages.cognia.agent-prompt.cognia-evidence.purp: Role instructions for Cognia’s knowledge organization and question answering
messages.cognia.ai.query-hint: Search this domain using your question, with up to 5 relevant materials.
messages.cognia.ai.question: Question or synthesis direction
messages.cognia.ai.synthesize-hint: Only the selected fixed material versions are sent to the model, up to 100,000 characters.
messages.cognia.confirm.delete-domain: Delete this domain? Its materials will move to Unclassified.
messages.cognia.confirm.delete-source: Delete this source and its current materials? Earlier fixed versions stay saved.
messages.cognia.confirm.remove-draft: Remove this draft from the list? Saved materials stay safe.
messages.cognia.confirm.remove-material: Remove this material from the current list? Earlier versions can still be read through fixed references.
messages.cognia.directory.summary: Import local knowledge and ask questions with sources.
messages.cognia.domain.name: Domain name
messages.cognia.draft.none: No drafts yet. Synthesize selected materials or ask a question.
messages.cognia.draft.review-hint: This AI draft needs your review. Check its text and sources before saving to your knowledge base.
messages.cognia.draft.title: Review knowledge draft
messages.cognia.edit.title: Edit material
messages.cognia.field.title: Title
messages.cognia.help.advanced: Preserves Markdown, folder layout, and attachments; unsupported formats are skipped and listed rather than dropped silently.
messages.cognia.help.example-1: Import a local notes folder into a domain with source-backed lookup
messages.cognia.help.example-2: Search full text by topic and jump straight to the original passage
messages.cognia.help.scope: Reads only the folders you pick; full-text search runs locally, and model-assisted answers are billed by your connected model provider.
messages.cognia.help.title: Cognia
messages.cognia.help.what: Your personal knowledge base shared across projects: import local Markdown folders or reference files and search with exact citations.
messages.cognia.import.confirm-hint: Import this fixed preview. Matching source paths are updated and earlier versions are kept.
messages.cognia.import.folder-hint: Without uploaded files, Preview import opens your system folder chooser.
messages.cognia.import.guide-limits: Preserves Markdown, folders, and attachments. Database relations, query views, block references, and dynamic plugins aren’t reconstructed. Convert ENEX, JEX, .sy, SQLite, and OneNote formats first; skipped files show a reason.
messages.cognia.import.guide-tools: Obsidian and Logseq file graphs: choose the Markdown folder. Notion: export Markdown and CSV, then unzip. Joplin: export Markdown + Front Matter. SiYuan, Anytype, Bear, Apple Notes, and Logseq DB: export Markdown first. LLM Wiki is a knowledge workflow, not a proprietary format.
messages.cognia.import.hint: Copies files as they are now without changing source folders. Up to 1,000 files / 32 MB per batch (2 MB per text file, 8 MB per attachment).
messages.cognia.import.nothing: No importable content found. Review the skipped files and choose a Markdown export folder.
messages.cognia.import.refresh-failed: Import finished, but the list couldn’t refresh. Close this dialog and try loading again.
messages.cognia.import.too-many: A batch supports up to 1,000 files. Choose a smaller folder.
messages.cognia.list.empty-hint: Import a Markdown folder, or add a material.
messages.cognia.list.no-match-hint: Try another keyword, or clear the filters to see all materials.
messages.cognia.manage.title: Manage categories
messages.cognia.model.none: No text model is configured yet. Import, search, and reading still work.
messages.cognia.reading.attachment-note: Attachment saved. You can download the original file — its contents aren’t executed or extracted here.
messages.cognia.reading.heading: Materials
messages.cognia.resume.model-ready: The model you set up is ready
messages.cognia.skip.too-large: Exceeds file or batch size limit
messages.cognia.skip.truncated: Folder is too large and was truncated
messages.cognia.source.name: Source name
messages.cognia.cap.directory-scan.description: Scan a local folder you authorized in read-only mode, skipping symlinks, hidden items, and unsupported types while honoring file and batch size limits.
messages.cognia.cap.directory-scan.title: Scan authorized folder
messages.cognia.cap.domain-create.description: Create a new knowledge domain. If a domain with the same name already exists, returns the existing one without duplicating it.
messages.cognia.cap.domain-create.title: Create knowledge domain
messages.cognia.cap.domain-delete.description: Delete a knowledge domain, move its materials, sources, and drafts to Unclassified, and clear its pending import previews. Saved material versions stay intact.
messages.cognia.cap.domain-delete.title: Delete knowledge domain
messages.cognia.cap.domain-update.description: Rename an existing knowledge domain while keeping all material links and references intact.
messages.cognia.cap.domain-update.title: Rename knowledge domain
messages.cognia.cap.draft-archive.description: Move a review draft out of the pending list while keeping any saved materials and their citations intact.
messages.cognia.cap.draft-archive.title: Archive review draft
messages.cognia.cap.draft-get.description: Read an active review draft along with the fixed material versions cited when it was generated. Read-only.
messages.cognia.cap.draft-get.title: Read review draft
messages.cognia.cap.draft-save.description: Save a reviewed draft as a material in your Cognia library. Saving the same draft again returns the existing material without creating duplicates.
messages.cognia.cap.draft-save.title: Save draft to library
messages.cognia.cap.files-entries.description: List files in your Cognia library page by page for the sidebar Files tab. Read-only.
messages.cognia.cap.files-entries.title: List Cognia files
messages.cognia.cap.import-cancel.description: Discard an uncommitted import preview while keeping all previously confirmed imports intact.
messages.cognia.cap.import-cancel.title: Cancel import preview
messages.cognia.cap.import-commit.description: Commit an import preview all at once. Retrying the same preview returns the original result, and any conflict stops the whole batch with no partial import.
messages.cognia.cap.import-commit.title: Confirm material import
messages.cognia.cap.import-directory-preview.desc: Read files from an authorized folder to build an import preview without accessing unauthorized paths. Nothing is saved to your library until you confirm.
messages.cognia.cap.import-preview.description: Validate uploaded files and save an import preview before writing anything to your library. The source label only records provenance and never reads local paths.
messages.cognia.cap.import-preview.title: Preview file import
messages.cognia.cap.knowledge-query.description: Search relevant materials in a selected domain and use a text model to draft an answer citing fixed versions. Doesn’t call the model if no supporting materials are found.
messages.cognia.cap.knowledge-query.title: Answer from knowledge base
messages.cognia.cap.knowledge-synthesize.descript: Use a text model to synthesize 1 to 5 materials into a draft with citations, using either specific saved versions or current versions. Nothing is added to your library until you save the draft.
messages.cognia.cap.knowledge-synthesize.title: Synthesize knowledge materials
messages.cognia.cap.material-create.description: Save a new manually written text material in your Cognia library as its first version.
messages.cognia.cap.material-create.title: Create manual material
messages.cognia.cap.material-delete.description: Remove a material from your current list. Earlier saved version references remain valid.
messages.cognia.cap.material-delete.title: Delete current material
messages.cognia.cap.material-download.description: Download the original file, file name, and file type for a saved material version. File contents are treated as untrusted reference material. Read-only.
messages.cognia.cap.material-download.title: Download original Cognia file
messages.cognia.cap.material-get.description: Read the current or a specific saved version of a material with its text, links, and citations. Saved versions stay readable even after the current material is removed. Read-only.
messages.cognia.cap.material-get.title: Read Cognia material
messages.cognia.cap.material-search.description: Search imported knowledge materials without modifying anything, returning saved versions and the first 600 characters of up to 30 matches. Never reads arbitrary local paths.
messages.cognia.cap.material-search.title: Search Cognia materials
messages.cognia.cap.material-update.description: Edit a manual or library material and save it as a new version. Checks the last-read version tag and rejects stale edits if the material changed.
messages.cognia.cap.material-update.title: Edit Cognia material
messages.cognia.cap.search-entries.description: List all searchable Cognia materials in versioned pages so search can build and update its index. Read-only.
messages.cognia.cap.search-entries.title: List searchable Cognia materials
messages.cognia.cap.source-delete.description: Delete an import source along with its current materials and pending previews. Referenced saved versions remain intact.
messages.cognia.cap.source-delete.title: Delete import source
messages.cognia.cap.source-update.description: Change the display name of an import source. Built-in manual and knowledge-base sources can’t be renamed.
messages.cognia.cap.source-update.title: Rename import source
messages.cognia.cap.subject-read.description: Read a Cognia material’s current text, version, and links for accurate reference. Read-only.
messages.cognia.cap.subject-read.title: Read Cognia material and links
messages.cognia.cap.workspace-get.description: Read material summaries, domains, sources, and pending review drafts filtered by keyword, domain, or source. Read-only.
messages.cognia.cap.workspace-get.title: Read Cognia library
messages.cognia.permission.cognia-read.reason: Read and search your imported Cognia materials, saved versions, and review drafts
messages.cognia.permission.cognia-write.reason: Import, create, edit, or delete domains, sources, materials, and drafts in Cognia
messages.cognia.permission.directory-read.reason: Read local folders you explicitly authorize so you can preview and import materials
messages.cognia.permission.model-invoke.reason: Use your configured text model to synthesize selected materials or answer questions with citations
messages.cognia.permission.storage-private.reason: Store your Cognia knowledge base, saved material versions, and review drafts locally
